references.text: This verse mentions the first census of the tribe of Ephraim, which also counts 40,500 men, the same number as in chapter 2.
The second census of the tribe of Ephraim on the plains of Moab, showing the change in the size of the tribe over time.
Previous verse identifying that this is the tribe of Ephraim under the leadership of Elishama son of Ammihud.
Describes when the camp of Ephraim broke camp during the wilderness journey, with the same leadership.
